\documentclass[11pt,oneside]{article}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usepackage[paperwidth=160mm,paperheight=180mm,margin=16mm]{geometry}
\usepackage{dirtreex}

\usepackage{zref-savepos,etoolbox}
\newcommand{\RGmark}[1]{\zsavepos{rg-\RGcase-#1}}
\makeatletter
\let\RGname\DirtreexFormatName
\renewcommand{\DirtreexFormatName}[1]{\RGmark{n#1}\RGname{#1}}
\patchcmd{\dte@render@root}{\dte@normalize@rowbox}{%
  \typeout{RG-RAW|\RGcase|\number\ht\dte@tbox|\number\dp\dte@tbox|\number\wd\dte@tbox}%
  \dte@normalize@rowbox}{}{\errmessage{Cannot probe root dimensions}}
\patchcmd{\dte@render@root}{\dte@normalize@rowbox}{%
  \dte@normalize@rowbox
  \typeout{RG-NORM|\RGcase|\number\ht\dte@tbox|\number\dp\dte@tbox|\number\wd\dte@tbox}%
  \typeout{RG-BLS|\RGcase|\number\dte@bls}%
}{}{\errmessage{Cannot probe normalized dimensions}}
\let\RGoutput\dte@output@framed
\def\dte@output@framed{%
  \typeout{RG-FRAME|\RGcase|\number\ht\dte@framebox|\number\dp\dte@framebox|\number\wd\dte@framebox}%
  \RGoutput}
\let\RGconnector\dte@draw@connector
\def\dte@draw@connector#1{%
  \typeout{RG-CONN|\RGcase|#1|\number\dte@scratch}%
  \RGconnector{#1}}
\makeatother
\pagestyle{empty}


\begin{document}
\begingroup\def\RGcase{1}
\noindent\RGmark{before}Before paragraph.\par\vspace{30pt}


\begin{dirtreex}[box=true,pagebreak=false,fontsize=\small,box={border color=red},line color=blue]
\verbfile[icon={\textcolor{green!50!black}{+}}]|ROOT_$%#&~^{}|{\RGmark{c1}Comment01\RGmark{e1}}
\end{dirtreex}

\par\noindent\RGmark{after}After paragraph.\par\endgroup
\clearpage
\begingroup\def\RGcase{2}
\noindent\RGmark{before}Before paragraph.\par\vspace{30pt}


\begin{dirtreex}[box=true,pagebreak=false,fontsize=\small,box={border color=red},line color=blue]
\verbfile[icon={\textcolor{green!50!black}{+}}]|ROOT_$%#&~^{}|{\RGmark{c1}Comment01\RGmark{e1}\\\RGmark{c2}Comment02\RGmark{e2}\\\RGmark{c3}Comment03\RGmark{e3}\\\RGmark{c4}Comment04\RGmark{e4}}
\end{dirtreex}

\par\noindent\RGmark{after}After paragraph.\par\endgroup
\end{document}
